{"rules": ["Model consistently underestimates volatility and fails to capture sudden upward spikes (e.g., Jan 14-16), resulting in a systematic negative bias during high-impact events.", "Forecasts exhibit extreme lag, predicting flat trends while true outcomes show sharp V-shapes or steep rallies; the model ignores momentum shifts signaled by sentiment changes.", "When sentiment history shows isolated positive spikes (0.20) amidst neutral noise, the model fails to react, leading to significant underperformance during breakout periods.", "The model assumes mean reversion toward a static baseline (~78-79), whereas true outcomes demonstrate range expansion and trend acceleration once volatility increases.", "Correction heuristic: Apply a dynamic upward adjustment factor when sentiment history contains recent positive signals or when the last 3 days of history show a low-low pattern followed by a spike in true outcome variance."]
